subject: Correct construction of animal model in animalINLA R package

messages.author: 5119d5398bc1a1af
messages.subject: Correct construction of animal model in animalINLA R package
parts:
Dear R-inla discussion group,

Please give me solution how to construct animal model properly in animalINLA R package, since I have problem with inclusion of multiple fixed effects.

I need to include "rs", "s1", "d", and "w" as a fixed effects, of which "d" and "w" are continuous factors, in model constructed in animalINLA R package.

What would be correct notation of such a model?

Please extend the model below:

a1 <- animal.inla("trait", "rs", genetic="id", Ainverse=Ainv, data=pheno, type.data = "gaussian")
